label: Partial truthmaking condition in…: If x makes p true, necessarily p is true if both x and p exist
term: partial truthmaking condition in Merricks’s précis
definition: If x makes p true, necessarily p is true if both x and p exist. This is only a necessary condition. Neither a world-immanence axiom nor a sufficient relevance/aboutness analysis follows from it.
note: Selected-world encoding of the partial necessary condition only; both bearer and proposition existence guard truth at accessible worlds. Proposition existence is an explicit primitive parameter with OPEN ontological interpretation. Making reuses the primitive bearer-to-fact relation, not implication or efficient causation. Aboutness/relevance and applicability remain OPEN; no sufficient definition of grounding is claimed. Frame and carriers are unrestricted parameters; rigid proposition availability and self-access are not assumed.
